attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 11
attributes.name: Hand of Glory
attributes.powers:
Display this card next to the deck of a character at your location. While displayed, add 1d8 to that character's Stealth check, and he may evade non-villain, non-henchman monsters he encounters.

At the end of the turn, roll 1d6. On 1–3, bury this card and suffer a scourge; on 4–6, recharge this card.

checks.text: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 11

corrections.corrected_text: On the item Hand of Glory, in the second power, delete "you may".
corrections.issue: Is rolling at the end of your turn for Hand of Glory really optional?
